title.en: A local chat endpoint for Antigravity
title.zh: 給 Antigravity 的本機聊天端點

description.en: A Python standard-library server that connects OpenAI-compatible chat clients to the Antigravity CLI, with account selection and quota cooldowns.
description.zh: 使用 Python 標準函式庫的伺服器，把 OpenAI 相容聊天客戶端接到 Antigravity CLI，提供帳號選擇與配額冷卻。

eyebrow.en: A small connector for local tools
eyebrow.zh: 串接本機工具的小型連接器

headline.en: Keep the chat client. Connect it to agy.
headline.zh: 保留原本的聊天工具，接上 agy。

lede.en: Point a compatible client at a local chat-completions endpoint. The server passes requests to your authenticated Antigravity CLI and manages selection across your configured accounts.
lede.zh: 把相容客戶端指向本機的 chat-completions 端點。伺服器把請求交給已登入的 Antigravity CLI，並在設定的帳號之間選擇。

text.en: Compatible client → local server → agy CLI
text.zh: 相容客戶端 → 本機伺服器 → agy CLI

title.zh: 三個部分，一個本機端點。

body.en: Accept OpenAI-style chat requests and return normal or streamed responses through the CLI bridge.
body.zh: 接收 OpenAI 格式的聊天請求，透過 CLI 橋接回傳一般或串流回覆。

body.en: Choose round-robin or fill-first selection with per-account quota cooldowns. Authenticate each account through the CLI before adding it.
body.zh: 選擇輪替或優先填滿策略，依帳號處理配額冷卻。加入帳號前，先透過 CLI 完成登入。

body.en: Run the standard-library Python server directly or use the supplied systemd user-service template. The default bind is loopback.
body.zh: 直接執行使用標準函式庫的 Python 伺服器，或使用隨附的 systemd 使用者服務範本。預設只綁定本機迴圈位址。

title.en: Install the CLI, then connect the client.
title.zh: 先準備 CLI，再串接客戶端。

intro.en: You need Python 3.10+ and an installed, authenticated agy CLI. Copy the example configuration, list your account directories and start the server using the README instructions.
intro.zh: 需要 Python 3.10 以上，以及已安裝、已登入的 agy CLI。複製範例設定、列出帳號目錄，再依 README 啟動伺服器。

body.en: Keep each account configuration in its own private directory outside the repository.
body.zh: 每個帳號的設定放在儲存庫之外的獨立私人目錄。

body.en: Start the server and inspect /health before connecting a chat client.
body.zh: 啟動伺服器，先檢查 /health，再連接聊天客戶端。

body.en: Set the client base URL to http://127.0.0.1:18795/v1 and test one request.
body.zh: 將客戶端 base URL 設為 http://127.0.0.1:18795/v1，先測試一個請求。

title.en: A focused bridge, available as source.
title.zh: 範圍明確的橋接工具，以原始碼提供。

intro.en: An early utility with no tagged release. Core client code is vendored from soyelmismo/hermes-antigravity-subscription under MIT; this repository adds the pool, server wrapper and systemd packaging.
intro.zh: 尚無 tag 發行版的早期工具。核心客戶端採用 soyelmismo/hermes-antigravity-subscription 的 MIT 程式碼；這個儲存庫加入帳號池、伺服器封裝與 systemd 設定。

works.en: Chat-completions, model-list and health endpoints are present in the source.
works.zh: 原始碼提供聊天完成、模型清單與健康檢查端點。

works.en: Both streamed and non-streamed replies, account selection and error mapping.
works.zh: 支援串流與非串流回覆、帳號選擇及錯誤對應。

limits.en: This is an OpenAI-compatible subset, not the complete OpenAI API. Tool calls are emulated and CLI host tools are denied.
limits.zh: 這是 OpenAI 相容介面的子集，不是完整 OpenAI API。工具呼叫以模擬方式處理，CLI 的主機工具會被拒絕。

limits.en: Requires your own authenticated CLI accounts and remains subject to their service access and quotas.
limits.zh: 需要自己已登入的 CLI 帳號，並受原服務的存取權限與配額限制。

limits.en: Keep the default loopback deployment. The wrapper supplies no production authentication layer for public exposure.
limits.zh: 維持預設的本機部署方式；這層封裝沒有提供對外公開服務所需的正式驗證層。
